fields.why: Race/ethnicity is a named t-test subgroup and the text reports a finding by race ('Differences ... by race/ethnicity ... were similar to patterns observed'), with group values in Supplementary Table 1; that is a stratifier, not a descriptor (population description or limitation-only mention).

brief_issues: The brief does not say which role an SPD gets when its stratified results are stated in the text but the values appear only in a supplementary table.
